base: Original circuit. Earlier PN/LN-to-ORN gate is not stacked.
targets: All 686 ALPN fixed by class; not selected from incoming-edge strengths
audit_high_selection: Per-control trial OFF19-20s >=100Hz, descriptive only; also report all-PN and common-high cohort
gate_semantics: Arrival time only, both OFF periods. Reconstruct unblocked input in original float event order. ON arrivals always pass. No v/g reset, no permanent edge changes, no other gate.
sequence: Eight control arrival audits first. Save and inspect audit report. Prespecified eLN output candidate only. One seed at gain1 validates all gate modes, then remaining 7 paired conditions. No new edge chosen from this audit.
interpretation: Only PN OFF20 mean <=3Hz is quiescence criterion. A positive-LN-only gate producing this supports necessity of that output route in this model, not sufficiency or unique biological cause. If not quiet, return to the measured input composition; do not add an unplanned gate. GABA is separate; do not attribute earlier DM1 increase definitively to one inhibitory edge. Labels are reproduction conditions, not new hunger physiology.
